definitions.explanation: A Japanese syllable produced with vocal cord vibration, indicated by the dakuten (゛) diacritical mark. For example, か→が, さ→ざ, た→だ, は→ば. One of the fundamental concepts in Japanese phonology.

examples.japanese: {濁音|だくおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}しましょう→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。

⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{濁音|だくおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「が{行|ぎょう}」「ざ{行|ぎょう}」「だ{行|ぎょう}」「ば{行|ぎょう}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|ぎょう}→行：26669_gyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese voiced sounds include four rows: the ga-row, za-row, da-row, and ba-row.

notes:
Compound of {濁|だく} (muddied, voiced) + {音|おん} (sound). The ⟦{濁点|だくてん}→濁点：27818_dakuten⟧ (゛) mark added to kana to indicate voicing is sometimes called "⟦{点々|てんてん}→点々：03974_tenten⟧" (dots) in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濁音|だくおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ — to add voicing
- {濁音|だくおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧ — pronunciation of voiced sounds
- {濁音|だくおん}⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧ — voicing mark (dakuten)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{清音|せいおん}→清音：23458_seion⟧ — voiceless sound (unvoiced kana, e.g., ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, さ, た)
- ⟦{半濁音|はんだくおん}→半濁音：23453_handakuon⟧ — half-voiced sound (ぱ, ぴ, ぷ, ぺ, ぽ)
- ⟦{濁点|だくてん}→濁点：27818_dakuten⟧ — dakuten, the ゛ mark
- {半濁点|はんだくてん} — handakuten, the ゜ mark
- {連濁|れんだく} — sequential voicing (voicing at compound boundaries)
